The Dream

Francis Burdett Money-Coutts (1852–1923)

H
AIL,
 bright morning beam!
Now my task retaking,
I indite the dream
God for me is making.
We may draw our theme,
Management, and measure
Out of Earth; the dream
Comes of God’s good pleasure.
